owner: ADVI_BILLING (AB-e-4 writes the parser; AB-e-6 reads the silver partition)
grain: one row per account allocation (AllocationID); billed in advance
header_rule: the header row is the first row (within 60) carrying AllocationID, Brokerage Account Number and Fee Debit, compared case- and whitespace-insensitively; extra columns are kept under their snake_case names as strings; the Deficit Report variant is the same layout on a sheet named like '49F Q3-26 Deficit Details'
source_columns_note: the export carries 33 columns (issuer measurement); the 23 below are the ones this contract names and types; the other 10 pass through untyped
rates_rule: every *_fee_rate is an ANNUAL FRACTION (0.0100 = 100 basis points a year); a source cell written with a percent sign is divided by 100
fee_rule: fee = Current Period Estimate Valuation x rate x Days in Period / Days in Year (251 trading days); Fee Debit = Net SmartX Fee + Net Advisor Fee and carries the prior-quarter true-up

source_columns.name: AllocationID
source_columns.meaning: SMArtX's id of the account allocation (sleeve); the statement has one row per allocation

source_columns.name: Brokerage Account Number
source_columns.meaning: custodian (Schwab) account number, zero padded to 10 digits

source_columns.name: Sleeve Type
source_columns.meaning: the allocation's sleeve type

source_columns.name: Model Name
source_columns.meaning: the model the allocation follows

source_columns.name: Fee Period Start
source_columns.meaning: first day of the fee period

source_columns.name: Fee Period End
source_columns.meaning: last day of the fee period

source_columns.name: SmartX Prior Quarter Estimate
source_columns.meaning: USD, SMArtX platform fee estimated for the prior quarter

source_columns.name: SmartX Prior Quarter Actual
source_columns.meaning: USD, SMArtX platform fee actual for the prior quarter

source_columns.name: SmartX True-Up
source_columns.meaning: USD, prior-quarter SMArtX platform true-up (actual less estimate) carried into this quarter's fee

source_columns.name: Advisor Prior Quarter Estimate
source_columns.meaning: USD, advisor fee estimated for the prior quarter

source_columns.name: Advisor Prior Quarter Actual
source_columns.meaning: USD, advisor fee actual for the prior quarter

source_columns.name: Advisor True-Up
source_columns.meaning: USD, prior-quarter advisor true-up carried into this quarter's fee

source_columns.name: UMA Fee Rate
source_columns.meaning: annual fraction, SMArtX UMA platform rate

source_columns.name: APM Fee Rate
source_columns.meaning: annual fraction, APM rate

source_columns.name: Model Fee Rate
source_columns.meaning: annual fraction, model manager rate

source_columns.name: Advisor Fee Rate
source_columns.meaning: annual fraction, the advisor's rate

source_columns.name: Client Fee Rate
source_columns.meaning: annual fraction, total rate charged to the client

source_columns.name: Current Period Estimate Valuation
source_columns.meaning: USD, the valuation the current period's fee is estimated on

source_columns.name: Days in Period
source_columns.meaning: trading days in the fee period

source_columns.name: Days in Year
source_columns.meaning: year basis in trading days (251)

source_columns.name: Net SmartX Fee
source_columns.meaning: USD, the SMArtX platform fee for the period, true-up included

source_columns.name: Net Advisor Fee
source_columns.meaning: USD, the advisor fee for the period, true-up included

source_columns.name: Fee Debit
source_columns.meaning: USD, Net SmartX Fee + Net Advisor Fee: the amount debited, carrying the prior-quarter true-up
